title: Extending GPU Ray-Tracing Units for Hierarchical Search Acceleration
problem: GPU ray-tracing units are specialized for graphics APIs and cannot be easily adapted to accelerate general-purpose hierarchical search algorithms, which are characterized by extensive branching and recursion. These algorithms are fundamental in recommendation systems and point cloud registration but lack efficient hardware support.
motivation: Hierarchical search is a critical pattern in important domains like recommendation systems and point cloud registration, but GPUs struggle to accelerate it efficiently.
method: The Hierarchical Search Unit takes the specialized circuitry that GPUs use for ray-tracing (following light paths through 3D graphics) and redesigns it for hierarchical search—the branching, tree-like exploration in recommendation systems and point cloud registration. Rather than rebuild from scratch, the authors reuse the existing datapath (circuits that process data) and add support for more flexible commands (instruction set) and new computations that search algorithms need. This keeps the hardware compatible with GPUs' general computing interface instead of limiting it to graphics APIs.
key_novelty: GPU ray-tracing hardware can be generalized to accelerate hierarchical search algorithms (used in recommendation systems and point cloud registration) by reusing its functional units (specialized processing components) with a more flexible datapath (the circuits and connections that route data).
contributions: Hierarchical Search Unit (HSU) design that extends ray-tracing acceleration to general-purpose hierarchical search algorithms
Functional unit reuse strategy that minimizes hardware overhead when extending ray-tracing units
Performance improvements on multiple hierarchical search data structures including approximate nearest neighbors and B-tree indexing
Integration with GPU's general computing interface, avoiding graphics API limitations
baselines: state-of-the-art GPU approximate nearest neighbor implementations
limitations: Limitations not discussed in the provided abstract.
primary_theme: generalizing GPU ray-tracing hardware for hierarchical search
